entities.summary: Chahida Ben Fraj Bouraoui, is an engineer, politician and deputy of the Assembly of the Representatives of the People as a representative of the Ennahda Movement. She was Secretary of State for Housing from 24 December 2011 to 29 January 2014, with Mohamed Salmane, Minister of Infrastructure and Environment.
